newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: New Clicks busy after foreign trade deal.
newsitem.headline: New Clicks busy after foreign trade deal.

text.p: Volumes in South African retail group New Clicks Holdings Ltd rose sharply on Thursday following a foreign trade deal involving 2.8 million shares by stockbroking firm Syfrets Securities Ltd, dealers said.
By 1017 GMT New Clicks shares were up five cents, or 1.01 percent, to 500 cents with 3.8 million shares worth around 19 million rand changing hands.
"This was a London deal we made at five rand (per share)," Richard Pyott, managing director of Syfrets Securities told Reuters.
He declined to give further details.
One Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) dealer said that it had been an overnight foreign sell transaction worth around 14 million rand.
"It was a late overnight sale of New Clicks over the boarder," the dealer said.
New Clicks was the second largest volume leader on the JSE.
